title: finding(cli): a SEVENTH `body`-dialect producer objectui#7181's table never named — `objectui generate page` scaffolds `pages/NAME.json` with a `body` child list
body:
objectui#7181's producer table names **six** files that emit `body`-spelled metadata into a file a user then owns. There is a **seventh**, and it is the same shape: `objectui generate page` writes a `pages/NAME.json` whose child list is spelled `body`.

Surfaced by the `os-dev` delivering objectui#7181 (PR objectui#9846) as an out-of-scope finding — it sits outside that card's amended fence — and **re-measured at source by the filing seat** on `origin/main` `276d1745` at 2026-09-18T09:34Z. ⛔ Not carried into that PR.

## The fact, read as a block

`packages/cli/src/commands/generate.ts`, `generatePage`:

```ts
:57  function generatePage(cwd: string, name: string) {
...
:69    const content = {
:70      type: "page",
:71      title: name,
:72      body: [
:73        {
:74          type: "markdown",
:75          content: `# Welcome to ${name}`
:76        }
:77      ]
:78    };
:79
:80    writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(content, null, 2));
```

⇒ a **producer in exactly objectui#7181's sense**: code that emits `body`-spelled metadata into a file the user then owns and re-authors. Same failure ordering applies — ship objectui#6771 step 4 (the tier teaches `children` only) before this moves, and `objectui generate page` produces a file the very next `objectui validate` rejects.

**Control, same instrument, same run:** the same pattern resolves **53** times in `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts` on the same ref (its pre-migration state), so the single hit here is a positive result and ⛔ not an empty pathspec.

## Why it is filed rather than swept into objectui#9846

objectui#7181's file surface was amended once already, by a delegated ruling, to add two vscode readers. ⛔ It is ⛔ not amended again by a dev mid-flight, and a seventh producer is ⛔ not a rider on a PR that has already grown once. One occurrence, mechanically identical to the six that PR migrated ⇒ a small, well-shaped follow-up.

⚠️ **The migration is only safe once objectui#9846 lands**, for the same reason objectui#7181 could not move its producers before its readers: `packages/vscode-extension/src/providers/{SchemaValidator,PreviewProvider}.ts` read `schema.body` alone on today's `origin/main`, so a `children`-spelled `pages/NAME.json` gets a **silently blank** VS Code preview and children that are never validated. ⇒ this card wants `Blocked-by: objectui#7181` in its **body** (⛔ not in a comment — the unlock sweep greps the body line, and this lane has already paid for that distinction once on objectui#7181 itself).

## Two things measured and deliberately NOT claimed

- ⛔ This seat did **not** re-run objectui#7181's census instrument, so it does ⛔ not assert that seven is now the complete population. The delivering dev reported this as 「the one app-metadata row the after-census still reports」; that is **transcribed**, ⛔ not re-taken here. ⇒ whoever takes this card re-runs `pnpm census:body-dialect` first and reports whether seven is the whole set.
- ⛔ No other `generate*` function in that file was checked for the same shape. `generatePlugin` begins at `:84` and was ⛔ not read.

## Dedupe words

- `generate.ts` body producer
- `objectui generate page` body
- `generatePage` pages json body
- seventh producer body dialect
- cli generate child list
